description: Aero Spacelines Super Guppy SGT c/n 003, one of the four outsize freighters that carried Airbus sections between the European plants until the Beluga replaced them. Preserved on the Dr.-Georg-Mecke-Museumsinsel at the Finkenwerder plant.
Ex-Luftwaffe Transall C-160D, Werknummer 84, delivered to the Airbus Finkenwerder museum meadow where it also serves as an apprentice training airframe.
Ex-French Air Force Noratlas No. 157, later civil D-NORA, preserved on the Airbus Finkenwerder museum meadow.
Hamburger Flugzeugbau HFB 320 Hansa Jet, c/n 1021, the forward-swept-wing business jet designed and built at Finkenwerder itself. Preserved on the Airbus museum meadow.

Ex-Luftwaffe HFB 320 Hansa Jet ECM aircraft, c/n 1025, held at Finkenwerder by the association Ein HANSA JET für Hamburg e.V. which is working towards returning it to flying condition; not part of the static museum display.

VFW 614 c/n G-015, one of only 19 built; previously stored at the Airbus plant in Bremen and moved to the Finkenwerder museum meadow in 2018, where apprentices restored its exterior. The Bremen-built VFW 614 was Germany's first post-war jet airliner.
Early production Airbus A320-100, msn 4, ex-Air France; retained at Finkenwerder and used as a freighter-conversion mock-up and training airframe on the museum island.
Fuselage section only of Airbus A321-211 msn 674, ex-CSA Czech Airlines, retained at Finkenwerder for cabin and maintenance training. Recorded here as a fuselage section, not a complete aircraft.
